_readme: Cookbook item functional overrides. Keys are prefab Name or Prefab string. ChangesEnabled must be true for StackSize to apply. Files in Items/ merge per-field with other item override files — appearance and functional fields coexist cleanly.
_stackSize_readme: StackSize sets the maximum stack size for this item (patches ItemData.MaxAmount on the server). Server-side only — never synced to Soul.
